title: Paradox of Acceptance — Essays
description: Long-form writing on what mindfulness does to a person — the structural tensions, the beliefs that dissolve, and the questions worth sitting with.

items.title: Life When You Win, Life When You Lose
items.summary: If this moment is already perfect whether you win or lose, why strive for anything? An essay on the motivation dilemma at the heart of non-dual mindfulness practice.
